name: Understudy
author: Nine Point Labs
description: Make a second Omarchy laptop match the main one. On the main laptop it lists the packages, Omarchy installers, themes, plugins, web apps and TUI launchers added since the first install and writes them to one plain file in a shared folder; on the second it shows what is missing by category (with categories you never want skipped), the exact commands, and installs the ones you tick in a terminal. Never removes anything; it only reminds you of what the main laptop dropped.
